_provenance: Modelled, not a live capture. X API v2 429 for the monthly usage cap (COST-7): problem type `usage-capped`, title `UsageCapExceeded`, as documented at docs.x.com/x-api/fundamentals/errors (usage-capped). It deliberately carries a near window reset, so a mapper that treated it as a rate limit would invite a pointless retry. Captured 2026-09-23. Exercises: billing class from a 429, distinct from rate-limit and from the local budget.
